title: Implement department communications and receipts
goal: Provide secure department, selected-person, and assignment communication audiences with durable delivery, read, and acknowledgment receipts.

out: Granting all organization members access to every department message

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Managers communicate only with authorized departments
Recipients are explicit and historical receipt rows are durable
Delivery, read, and acknowledgment are separate states
Failed recipients retry without duplicating successful deliveries
Current workforce message consumers remain compatible during rollout

progress.summary: Blocked on canonical departments, memberships, and authority.

SOCIAL-004 and SOCIAL-007 remain active; keep lib/messaging/** and the notification/follow paths disjoint from this lane.
Implement audiences, receipts, retries, and compatibility
blockers: SOCIAL-004/SOCIAL-007 working-set overlap must be cleared
